-- Full query with correct pit stop logic
WITH pit_stops_clean AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap AS pit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap >= 2
),
consecutive_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id, driver_id, 
        lap AS current_lap, 
        position AS current_position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position,
        LAG(lap) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_lap
    FROM race_laps
),
pit_stop_related AS (
    -- Pit entry: comparing (pit_lap-1) to (pit_lap)
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, pit_lap AS affected_lap
    FROM pit_stops_clean
    UNION ALL
    -- Pit exit: comparing (pit_lap) to (pit_lap+1)
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, pit_lap + 1 AS affected_lap
    FROM pit_stops_clean
),
with_pit_info AS (
    SELECT 
        cl.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM pit_stop_related p 
                WHERE p.race_id = cl.race_id AND p.driver_id = cl.driver_id 
                AND p.affected_lap = cl.current_lap
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_pit_change
    FROM consecutive_laps cl
),
valid_changes AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, current_lap, current_position, prev_position
    FROM with_pit_info
    WHERE prev_position IS NOT NULL 
      AND is_pit_change = 0
      AND current_position != prev_position
),
classified AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN current_position < prev_position THEN 'overtake'
            WHEN current_position > prev_position THEN 'overtaken'
        END AS change_type
    FROM valid_changes
),
summary AS (
    SELECT driver_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN change_type = 'overtake' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overtakes,
           SUM(CASE WHEN change_type = 'overtaken' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_overtaken
    FROM classified
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT s.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, s.overtakes, s.times_overtaken
FROM summary s
JOIN drivers d ON s.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE s.times_overtaken > s.overtakes
ORDER BY s.times_overtaken - s.overtakes DESC
